name: client-ui-best-practices
description: Client UI threading and state-driven rendering practices.

interface.longDescription: Guides client development so UI-thread work stays focused on view updates and rendering, while business logic and I/O run asynchronously and update screens through observable UI state and one-time effects.
defaultPrompt: Review this client screen for main-thread violations.
Refactor this UI flow to StateFlow-driven rendering.
Move business work off the UI thread safely.
